claims.claim_text: Innoviz has a Level 3 LiDAR design-win on BMW's Level 3 platform via Magna under the 2018 BMW SOW; serial production volumes only binding upon issuance of purchase orders.
claims.subject: Innoviz Technologies
claims.object_value: BMW (via Magna Electronics Europe, 2018 BMW SOW)
claims.source_quote: In connection with the JDMSA, in February 2018, we entered into the BMW SOW with Magna Electronics Europe GmbH & Co. OHG ... to equip Innoviz LiDAR products into BMW s Level 3 vehicle platform. ... Serial production volumes will ultimately be highly dependent on numerous factors and therefore are binding only upon issuance of a purchase order.

claims.claim_text: Innoviz signed an electronic Nomination Agreement (eNA) with Cariad SE (Volkswagen Group) in December 2022 for development, manufacture, and delivery of InnovizTwo LiDARs; Cariad has rights to terminate including if Innoviz fails to meet prerequisites for series production.
claims.subject: Innoviz Technologies
claims.object_value: Cariad SE / Volkswagen Group (December 2022 eNA, InnovizTwo)
claims.source_quote: In December 2022, Innoviz and Cariad SE executed an electronic nomination agreement (the eNA) ... pursuant to which Cariad commissioned Innoviz to develop, manufacture and deliver InnovizTwo LiDARs. Cariad has the right to terminate the eNA under certain circumstances, including (a) if Innoviz does not meet the prerequisites for series production of the products that are the subject matter of the eNA, and (b) if Innoviz enters into insolvency proceedings.

claims.claim_text: Innoviz signed a December 2023 Magna Agreement for high-volume manufacturing of InnovizOne LiDARs at Magna's automotive-grade facility in Holly, Michigan for the BMW program.
claims.subject: Innoviz Technologies
claims.object_value: Magna automotive-grade facility, Holly, Michigan (for BMW program)
claims.source_quote: In December 2023, Innoviz signed an agreement with Magna Electronics Technology, Inc., and Magna Electronics Europe GmbH & Co. OHG (the Magna Agreement), addressing the high-volume manufacturing of Innoviz LiDARs at Magna s automotive grade facility in Holly, Michigan, for the BMW program.

claims.claim_text: Innoviz signed a 2024 Term Sheet with Mobileye Vision Technologies Ltd. for supply of Innoviz LiDARs for Mobileye programs.
claims.subject: Innoviz Technologies
claims.source_quote: In 2024, Innoviz signed a term sheet with Mobileye Vision Technologies Ltd., for the supply of Innoviz LiDARs for Mobileye programs (the Mobileye TS).

claims.claim_text: Innoviz signed a September 2025 long-term supply agreement with Daimler Truck North America LLC for supply of Innoviz LiDARs for Daimler's autonomous Cascadia.
claims.subject: Innoviz Technologies
claims.object_value: Daimler Truck North America LLC (autonomous Cascadia, supply agreement effective Sept 1, 2025)
claims.source_quote: Long Term Agreement with Daimler Truck Supply agreement made and entered into effect as of September 1, 2025, by Innoviz and Daimler Truck North America LLC, for the supply of Innoviz LiDARs for Daimler s autonomous Cascadia.

claims.claim_text: Innoviz holds a registered patent portfolio in LiDAR technology including 905nm lasers, MEMS, optics, and ASIC packaging.
claims.subject: Innoviz Technologies
claims.source_quote: We own a portfolio of intellectual property, including registered patents, registered trademarks, registered designs, confidential technical information, and expertise in the development of LiDAR technology and software for, among others, autonomous vehicles.

claims.claim_text: Innoviz is a going concern with sufficient cash (approx $72.1M at YE2025) to execute its business plan for at least the next 12 months despite operating cash burn of approx $47.9M in 2025 and net loss of $67.8M.
claims.subject: Innoviz Technologies
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2025, we had cash and cash equivalents, short term bank deposits, short term restricted cash and marketable securities of approximately $72.1 million. We expect those funds to be sufficient to continue to execute our business plan for at least the next 12 months.

claims.claim_text: Customer concentration: Customer A accounted for 81% of revenues for 2025 ($55.1M total revenues; Germany region $45.1M); 73% of trade receivables. Customer B accounted for 20% of revenues in 2024.
claims.subject: Innoviz Technologies
claims.object_value: Customer A = 81% of 2025 revenue; Germany-located customer
claims.source_quote: For the year ended 2025, Customer A accounted for 81% of revenues. ... Includes revenues from Germany in the amount of $45,132 ... in the year ended December 31, 2025.
